title: Sentinel 身份驗證
content:
Sentinel is the official authentication and authorization orbit for Photon. It provides a robust auth middleware and an AuthManager for complex security logic.

Setup

In the standalone engine, you can use the Sentinel middleware directly to protect your routes.

import { auth } from '@gravito/sentinel'

// Protect a specific route
app.get('/profile', auth(), (c) => {
  const user = c.get('auth').user()
  return c.json({ user })
})

Configuration

Sentinel supports multiple guards (JWT, Session). You can pass configuration to the middleware or initialize the AuthManager globally.

import { auth } from '@gravito/sentinel'

app.use('/api/*', auth('jwt'))
